# Customer segments

Segments are used in reports, not in pricing. See [terms](terms.md) and [plan tiers](../products/plan-tiers.md).

## Segments
Individual, small business, mid-market, enterprise and nonprofit. A nonprofit is any registered nonprofit regardless of size; discounts for them are in [discounts](../policies/discounts.md).
